[SWS_CORE_12403] Logging of Explicit Operation Abortion
⌈
Unless
logging is deactivated for this Application, calling ara::core::Abort shall result in a
log message with FATAL severity, which shall contain the string that has been passed
to the function as argument, being output via ara::log.
⌋

[SWS_CORE_12403] Logging of Explicit Operation Abortion
⌈
Calling
ara::core::Abort shall result in a log message, which shall contain the string that
has been passed to the function as argument, being output to the process’s standard
error stream.
⌋

[SWS_CORE_12403] Standard Error Stream Logging of Explicitly aborting an Operation
⌈
Calling ara::core::Abort shall result in a log message being output to the pro-
cess’ standard error stream. The log message shall contain the string representation
of the parameters that have been passed to the function as arguments, in the same
order that they have been passed.
⌋
